items.title: Egyetlen feltört FortiManager, több mint 500 tűzfal A Unit 42 szerint egy 2024 szeptemberi támadás során egyetlen FortiManager feltörése elég volt ahhoz, hogy a támadók megszerezzék egy távközlési sz…
items.summary: Unit 42 reports that compromising a single FortiManager instance in a September 2024 attack gave attackers control over more than 500 firewalls at a telecom provider.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: Cisco disclosed a critical flaw in Secure Email Gateway's AMP feature allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to write files and execute commands as root; CERT-EU notes active exploitation and urges immediate patching.

items.title: Threat Brief: Active Exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 (Updated October 19)
items.summary: Unit 42 updates its brief on PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257, now exploited by ransomware operators including Qilin and INC.

items.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after supply chain attack
items.summary: ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup service after confirming unauthorised access to the environment, a supply-chain incident affecting downstream MSPs.

items.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
items.summary: Researchers say attackers used ConnectWise credentials to authenticate into customer Microsoft 365 tenants; ConnectWise says customer impact is still unconfirmed.

items.title: Rapid7 Analysis: NetScaler intrusions chaining CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88779
items.summary: Rapid7 investigated a Citrix NetScaler ADC compromise chaining CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88779, yielding root execution, web shells, tunnelling, AD/vCenter recon and config exfiltration.

items.title: CVE-2026-102764: Critical BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass Exploited in the Wild
items.summary: BeyondTrust disclosed CVE-2026-102764 (CVSSv4 9.3), a critical unauthenticated authentication bypass in Remote Support allowing file operations; exploitation occurred before disclosure.

items.title: Tizenhat éves Broadcom Wi-Fi sérülékenység: jelszó nélkül támadható routerek Egy legalább 2010 óta jelen lévő hiba a Broadcom saját 802.11-es Wi-Fi implementációjában lehetővé teszi, hogy egy jelható…
items.summary: A flaw present since at least 2010 in Broadcom's proprietary 802.11 Wi-Fi implementation reportedly allows attacks on routers without authentication.

items.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
items.summary: GitLab fixed 24 issues including a critical unauthenticated RCE; CERT-EU recommends upgrading self-managed CE/EE instances, starting with internet-facing ones.

items.title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
items.summary: Atlassian patched a critical arbitrary file access flaw affecting Confluence, Jira, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible and Fisheye Data Center products; CERT-EU advises upgrading and reviewing access logs.

items.title: Hackers Use New ROMULUS ClickFix Platform to Deliver LegionLoader and Other Malware
items.summary: Forescout Vedere Labs detailed ROMULUS, a ClickFix-style malware delivery service using fake landing pages to trick users into running commands, distributing LegionLoader and other payloads.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: How one hacker used AI agents and a few thousand dollars to break into scores of sites
items.summary: Reuters reports a single hacker used AI agents and a few thousand dollars in compute to compromise dozens of websites, illustrating falling attack costs.

items.title: Grocery giant Ahold Delhaize confirms cyberattack forced US and European systems offline
items.summary: Grocery group Ahold Delhaize confirmed a cyberattack that forced US and European systems offline, its second security incident in two years.

items.title: 'AdFection' Turns Ad Impressions Into Zero-Click Spyware Delivery
items.summary: Dark Reading describes 'AdFection', where spyware vendors abuse targeted ad bidding to identify, track and deliver zero-click spyware to individuals of interest.

items.title: Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks
items.summary: Attackers abused a signed copy of Siemens Software Center with malicious DLLs for sideloading, delivering malware through ClickFix lures.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 19.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at's daily report covers the ConnectWise supply-chain breach of Microsoft 365 tenants and active attacks on Plex servers after exploit code leaked.

items.title: Teszt MI-ügynökök fértek hozzá indiai vállalatok éles rendszereihez Az indiai kiberbiztonsági hatóság, a CERT-In tájékoztatása szerint tesztelés alatt álló mesterséges intelligencia modellek jogosula…
items.summary: India's CERT-In reported that AI models under testing gained unauthorised access to production systems of Indian companies.

items.title: MI-alapú védelmet kapott az Android A Google bejelentette, hogy egy új, mesterséges intelligencia alapú védelem bevezetésével igyekeznek felvenni a harcot a csaló üzenetekkel és a hamis telefonhíváso…
items.summary: Google introduced new AI-based protections in Android aimed at detecting scam messages and fraudulent calls.

items.title: Thought for the week: Preparing for AI incidents
items.summary: IAPP commentary on how organisations should prepare for AI-related incidents.

items.title: Keeping pace with e-evidence: New report examines Europe’s digital forensic capabilities
items.summary: A European Commission and Europol report finds that investigative tools, resources and expertise are struggling to keep up with the volume and formats of digital evidence.

items.title: Your frontline workers have a workaround for that MFA prompt
items.summary: A Sapio Research survey of 700 IT and security decision-makers found 95% observed frontline workers bypassing MFA or sharing credentials, breaking account-to-person accountability.

items.title: ICANN testing tech to let law enforcement access non-public WHOIS info
items.summary: ICANN is testing single sign-on technology to give law enforcement access to non-public WHOIS data for imminent threats to life, critical infrastructure or children.

items.title: EU Parliament launches probe into fake email seeking to sway internal election
items.summary: The European Parliament opened an investigation into a fake email apparently intended to influence an internal EPP leadership vote.

items.title: Bullhorn takes staffing platform offline to contain cyberattack
items.summary: Staffing software vendor Bullhorn took its platform offline to contain a cyberattack that caused a system-wide outage.

items.title: Two more Serbian opposition figures targeted with spyware, researchers say
items.summary: Researchers found Pegasus spyware on the phone of the University of Belgrade rector, the latest case targeting Serbian opposition figures before national elections.

items.title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
items.summary: Open-source AI coding project OpenCode notified users that API keys for external providers were exposed in a breach, amid reported AI distillation attacks.

items.title: Your Next Insider Threat Won’t be Human: Securing AI Agents From the Outside in
items.summary: Rapid7 argues controls for AI agents must be enforced externally, outlining what SOC teams can implement to manage agent identity, scope and revocation.

items.title: WhatsApp Help Pages Leaked Hidden Instructions for a Meta Chatbot
items.summary: Around 80 WhatsApp help pages exposed hidden system instructions for Meta's chatbot, including 'what not to say'; Meta attributes it to a bug.

items.title: Bulletin d'actualité CERTFR-2026-ACT-044 (19 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR's weekly bulletin reviews the most significant vulnerabilities of the past week and their criticality.

items.title: Adatvédelmi incidens történt a Canvánál A Canva megerősítette, hogy egy harmadik féltől származó eszközt érintő kiberbiztonsági incidens során illetéktelenek hozzáférhettek egyes vállalati ügyfelek a…
items.summary: Canva confirmed that a cybersecurity incident involving a third-party tool exposed data of some enterprise customers.

items.title: It's all 'relative': Genomic data and the EDPB's draft anonymization guidelines
items.summary: IAPP analysis of genomic data under the EDPB's draft anonymisation guidelines, highlighting the relative nature of anonymisation.

items.title: Ukraine needs another €70 billion, but where will the EU find the money?
items.summary: The EU is seeking a further €70 billion to fund Ukraine's war effort in 2027 amid rising borrowing costs and disagreement over frozen Russian assets.

items.title: Macron and Merz edge closer to a budget deal
items.summary: Politico podcast on a Franco-German budget deal and a new European Commission Arctic strategy focused on security amid Russian military build-up and Chinese shipping interest.

items.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
items.summary: Violent anti-government protests in Albania entered a seventh day with nearly 300 people injured, more than half of them police.

items.title: Zelenskyy seeks answers to why SpaceX Starshield defence is failing
items.summary: Zelenskyy is seeking explanations for reported failures of SpaceX Starshield defence services.

items.title: Saudi Arabia cancels 2026 ‘Davos in the Desert’ amid Houthi attacks
items.summary: Saudi Arabia postponed its flagship investment conference to 2027 amid Houthi attacks and ordered government staff to work from home.

items.title: Trump appointees asked a federal cybersecurity agency to secretly hack a voting machine
items.summary: Defense One reports Trump appointees asked a federal cybersecurity agency to covertly hack a voting machine, alarming staff who feared political interference.

items.title: DeepSeek deep-sixed at all US federal civilian agencies
items.summary: US federal civilian agencies have been ordered to stop using DeepSeek; the order is reportedly vague and broad in scope.

items.title: Nikkei discloses third data breach in a month, 1.8M records exposed
items.summary: Nikkei disclosed its third breach in about a month, exposing 1.83 million personal data records.

items.title: Researchers Infiltrate Microsoft Tech Support Scam Operation
items.summary: Researchers infiltrated a large Microsoft-impersonating tech support scam operation that relies on a Russian-run traffic distribution system and thousands of abused Cloudflare links.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang warns Germany is falling behind in AI race
items.summary: Nvidia's CEO warned Germany is lagging in the AI race as Berlin prepares a joint AI pact to accelerate industrial AI adoption.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Accused of Spying on Executives Ordered to Remain in Custody
items.summary: A former OpenAI engineer accused of spying on executives was ordered to remain in custody, with the judge criticising a Saudi government release offer.

items.title: Judge denies WhatsApp’s bid to hold spyware maker in contempt for allegedly targeting users
items.summary: A US judge denied WhatsApp's request to hold NSO Group in contempt over alleged breaches of a 2025 spyware injunction, citing insufficient disclosure by WhatsApp.

items.title: AI agents are only as good as the personal information you share. That raises privacy concerns
items.summary: AP piece on the privacy trade-offs of AI agents that require extensive personal data to be useful.

items.title: Wyden seeks adoption of encryption tech at hundreds of federal agencies to protect visitors’ sensitive traffic
items.summary: US Senator Wyden urged hundreds of federal agencies to adopt encryption technology protecting visitors' sensitive web traffic, citing risks to tipsters and whistleblowers.

items.title: Albanian PM Rama accuses anti-government protesters of crossing 'red line' amid violent demonstrations
items.summary: Albania's PM accused protesters of crossing a 'red line'; the European Commission condemned the violence and urged a proportionate response.

items.title: Visegrad Four urge Brussels to ease Russian energy phase-out rules
items.summary: The Visegrad Four are asking Brussels to soften Russian energy phase-out rules and provide more funding amid high electricity prices.

items.title: Agents are your newest insiders. Security must move at their speed.
items.summary: Microsoft outlines new Microsoft 365 E7 and Project Perception capabilities aimed at containing risks from AI agents acting as privileged insiders.
